title: Poltergeist
tagline: Spirits in the house. Steak on the bench.
about: A suburban family's house is invaded by spirits who take their youngest daughter.
cue: Serve the steak when one crawls across the kitchen bench.

    StartersTV static popcornButtered popcorn, pepper and sesame static. They're here.How to make it120g popcorn kernels50g butter, melted1/2 tsp fine salt1 tsp cracked black pepper1 tbsp black sesame seedsPop the kernels in a lidded pot with a little oil.Toss with the butter, salt, pepper and sesame seeds until it looks like TV static.Serve in a bowl in front of the screen.Stacked chair cheese towerThick cheese slices stacked with crackers between each layerHow to make it150g cheddar150g gouda150g Swiss cheese16 crackersSlice the cheddar, gouda and Swiss cheese thickly.Stack in crooked towers with a cracker between each layer.Push a long skewer through the middle to hold each tower. Make four.Clown face pizza crackersThe clown doll on the chair, don't leave him thereHow to make itAs written, serves 4Round crackers loaded with cream cheese, salami, a cherry tomato nose and olive eyes, flashed under the grill so the cheese just melts.Mix 150g cream cheese with 50g grated mozzarella and a pinch of oregano.Spread onto 20 round crackers on a tray.Give each a thin round of salami from 100g as a face, half a cherry tomato for a nose, two slices of black olive for eyes and a strip of red capsicum for a grin.Grill for 2 minutes until the cheese is just melting and serve straight away.MainsSteak that stays putSeared rump steaks basted in garlic butter, with baked potatoesHow to make it4 potatoes1kg rump steak40g butter3 garlic cloves4 thyme sprigs300g spinach125ml thickened cream1 tsp saltBake the potatoes at 200°C.Season the steaks.Sear in a smoking pan, then add the butter, garlic and thyme to baste and pull at 54°C inside.Rest.Wilt the spinach with the cream and serve alongside.Cuesta Verde tuna pasta bakeA suburban weeknight dinner in the new estateHow to make itAs written, serves 4Pasta shells, tuna and peas folded through a sharp cheddar white sauce, topped with buttery breadcrumbs and baked until bubbling and golden.Boil 400g pasta shells for 2 minutes less than the packet says and drain.Melt 50g butter, stir in 50g flour, then whisk in 700ml milk and simmer 3 minutes.Stir in 200g grated cheddar, 1 tsp Dijon mustard and pepper.Fold through the pasta with 2 x 185g tins drained tuna and 200g frozen peas.Tip into a baking dish, top with 60g breadcrumbs mixed with 20g melted butter and bake at 200°C for 20 minutes.SweetsGhost-white meringuesCrisp white meringue. This house is clean.How to make it3 egg whites1 pinch cream of tartar180g caster sugarWhisk the egg whites with the cream of tartar to soft peaks.Add the sugar a spoon at a time until stiff and glossy.Pipe tall drops onto lined trays.Bake at 100°C for 90 minutes, then cool in the oven.DrinksCuesta Verde orange spiderOrange soda poured over vanilla ice creamHow to make it1 L vanilla ice cream1.3 L orange soda, coldPut scoops of ice cream in each of four glasses.Pour over the cold orange soda slowly so it foams.Serve straight away while it is still ice cold.
